I work on large language models and natural language processing — how to make AI systems reason better, stay grounded in evidence, and work reliably across languages, speech, and real-world data.

I'm currently an AI Researcher at Penta Global Ltd., working with a small research team on Bangla medical speech recognition, medical prescription understanding, and agentic test-time reinforcement learning. I went to sea first because I wanted a challenging, disciplined profession, and spent five years as a marine engineer on VLCC super tankers. In 2023 I came back to my first interest, computing: I started a B.Sc. in Computer Science & Engineering at BUBT from scratch, and since 2024 have studied alongside full-time industry work while holding a 4.00 CGPA.

02 Ongoing research

Reasoning & Claim Verification

Evidence Claim Pipeline (Thesis)

A system that extracts claims from scientific papers and reasons about the evidence and premises behind them, using claim verification and abductive reasoning with LLMs.

With Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Mir Sazzat Hossain, MD Fahim

Reasoning & Agents

Agentic Test-Time Reinforcement Learning

Applying test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) to LLM agents, so they can keep improving on new, unlabeled tasks using their own consensus as a reward signal.

With MD Fahim, Mir Sazzat Hossain, Intesar Tahmid, Galib Mahmud Jim, Md Mahir Jawad

Speech & Clinical AI

Bangla Dialectal Medical ASR Benchmark

A benchmark for clinically significant errors in Bangla dialectal medical speech recognition, built from synthetic doctor–patient conversations generated with LLMs and text-to-speech.

With MD Fahim, Mir Sazzat Hossain, Intesar Tahmid, Galib Mahmud Jim, Md Mahir Jawad

Speech & Clinical AI

Medical Prescription Understanding

Reading and structuring medical prescriptions with AI, so that drug names, dosages, and instructions can be extracted reliably.

With MD Fahim, Mir Sazzat Hossain, Intesar Tahmid, Galib Mahmud Jim, Md Mahir Jawad

Multilingual NLP

Human-Rights Dataset Extraction

Multi-stage LLM pipeline that turns a scanned Bangla source document into a structured, translated dataset, validated against an independent third-party dataset.

With AVNBD

From ship engine rooms to trustworthy AI

Merchant Navy · 2017 – 2023

For five years I kept the engines of VLCC super tankers running — main engines, generators, boilers — where every fault has to be traced from its symptoms back to a root cause, and a wrong call at sea has real consequences. I bring the same habit to AI research: treat model outputs as claims that need evidence, and make systems reliable before making them impressive.
